interest: Illuminates civilian versus naval Pacific trusteeship disputes, Allied occupation cost debates, and detailed socioeconomic conditions in postwar Okinawa.
overview: This file documents United States postwar policy and interdepartmental debates from 1945 to 1949 regarding the disposition and administration of former Japanese-mandated and Pacific islands, Far Eastern Commission deliberations over Japanese occupation costs and reparations, diplomatic strategies to limit Soviet and Chinese occupation forces in Japan, and conditions in occupied Okinawa.
